# Nithin Jambula

> Software engineer working on robotics and AI systems. Builds robot behavior, perception and simulation testing software, multi-agent LLM systems and RAG, with a focus on clean system design. Based in Amaravati, India. Open to software engineering roles in robotics and AI systems.

- Email: nithinjambula89@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/nithin434
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/nithin-jambula
- CV (PDF): https://nithin434.github.io/public/CV.pdf

## Experience
- Software Engineer, Robotics & Autonomy, Ananta Technologies (Dec 2025 – present): AprilTag-guided robot positioning, behavior trees with retries and fallbacks, a 50+ scenario MuJoCo/Webots test suite (35% faster validation), 2 robots taken from simulation to production, and rebuilt control links for CNC machines and H2D printers.
- Student Research Engineer, AIR Centre, VIT-AP University (Jun 2024 – Nov 2025): LLM agents with rule-based reasoning for API security testing (+34% vulnerabilities found, 70% less manual testing; IEEE AIRC 2026), and a real-time AI voice calling agent on Asterisk/ViciDial.
- Software Lead, Vulcan self-driving campus EV (Jan 2023 – present): DeepLabV3+ segmentation (67%), lane following, CARLA + SAC + DAgger, NVIDIA Jetson; showcased at VLaunchpad 2025.
- Machine Learning Engineer, Sripto (Dec 2023 – May 2024): RAG over private documents, PDF chatbots, NL-to-SQL.

## Projects
- [PatchPilot](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#patchpilot): multi-agent GitHub pull request review on LangGraph with ChromaDB memory.
- [Context-Preserving RAG](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#rag): hybrid vector + BM25 search with query routing and traceable answers.
- [16fps](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#16fps): multi-agent video generation; commercial rights sold.
- [EchoSight](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#echosight): navigation glasses, YOLOv8 at 45+ FPS on a Raspberry Pi; patent pending; Vikas 2024 awardee.
- [AprilTag Docking Rover](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#rover): ROS 2 rover with a docking mission state machine.
- [MatriAI](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#matriai): semantic profile matching with FastAPI, LangChain, ChromaDB and MongoDB.
- [AI Voice Calling Agent](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#voice-agent): real-time speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech calling agent.
